prompt:
Reference image 1 shows the chosen design of THE HOLLOW KING (HK-10). Keep the referenced design exactly — silhouette, proportions, colour palette, materials and rendering style — and show it in the new composition described below (framing and background follow the description, not the reference): SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, widescreen arcade key moment. The instant the final attack begins: seen from inside the closing maw of THE HOLLOW KING, the screen itself becoming the mouth. Enormous jaws of riveted steel teeth sweep in from the left edge and the top and bottom of the frame, the gap of visible dark water narrowing to a sliver; in the far distance of the narrowing gap, a tiny steel-blue fighter dart with a bold blue hull stripe and cyan canopy glows with a desperate orange engine flare, centered and doomed-looking. Above the sliver of water, suspended in the black like a malevolent star, the single pale-green lure lamp burns. The palette drains to almost monochrome deep navy #05070f–#0c1a3c with bone-white teeth, one green light, one orange flame — pink and violet bullet glints caught between the teeth. Widescreen 16:9 side-scrolling composition, overwhelming scale, subtle CRT scanline glow. No text, no letters. Darks stay a lifted deep navy, never pure black; no letterbox bars, no frame or border around the picture. Every player craft faces right: nose pointing to the right, engines and exhaust on the left. Enemy bullets are round glowing orbs with bright cores and dark rims. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.
 The water inside the mouth is one continuous deep navy with no horizon line and no pure black. The bullet glints between the teeth are small round pink and violet orbs, never dashes or pills. The lure is the reference's glowing pale-green star lamp on its curved iron stalk. Reference image 2 shows the player fighter: draw it small in the centre in the same side view and the same direction as reference 2, its pointed nose and cyan canopy toward the right edge of the picture and its orange engine flame on its left end.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, watermark, pure black background, blurry, bright cheerful colors
